sourceContext.originPage: WKND adventure detail page (Bali Surf Camp)

contentPattern.structure: image only per slide (no overlaid heading/description/CTA)

suitableFor: full-width image galleries with prev/next + dot indicators and NO overlay text
in-page photo carousels where the image is the only content
notSuitableFor: home/landing hero carousels with overlaid heading + CTA (use carousel-hero)
slides that must be populated dynamically from a query index (carousel-hero does that)

similarityEvaluation.reason: carousel-hero (base=carousel) is the only existing carousel variant. It is DARK (colorScheme dark vs light here → miss), full-bleed HERO with overlaid heading+description+CTA per slide, and destructively replaces authored slides with entries fetched from carousel-index.json. This adventure masthead is LIGHT and image-ONLY (no overlay, authored images, no dynamic injection). Purpose (hero vs masthead-gallery) and image/content structure differ; density matches. Weighted score well below the 0.8 reuse threshold, so a new image-only variant was created from the vanilla Block Collection carousel.

usage.notes: doc (non-xwalk) project: fetchPlaceholders and moveInstrumentation imports removed (not exported by scripts/aem.js or scripts/scripts.js here); slide-control aria labels use plain literals. JS class names renamed from base 'carousel-*' to 'carousel-mini-*'. Renders authored slides as-is (unlike carousel-hero's carousel-index.json injection). Prev/next controls only appear when >1 slide is authored.
